reviews.title: Asks for a positive review when I just installed it and am halfway through the intro
reviews.text: In psychology/research study methodology there’s a phenomena known as participant reactivity bias where participants try to please the person asking them a question/review. This app tries to take advantage of that plus peer pressure by showing users a page of positive reviews less than two minutes after I opened the app and am going through the intro. Absolutely disgusting.

reviews.title: Brilliant!
reviews.text:
I have been looking for an app almost exactly like this for a long time and making do with smaller apps and paper planning. While I still use paper planners for my scheduling, this one app has so many great features. If you already know your goals, routine, and reward system, this is all you need to add to the group and start maintaining habits! I love the distinction between habits you’re trying to build and the option to track quitting a bad habit. The price isn’t the worst I’ve seen and it’s a quality app without adds so I can’t complain! That said, I’d love to see a referral program or lifetime (larger charge) offer. All in all, fabulous app and I am excited to see all of the upcoming new features! I’m along for the ride! 
PS - their customer service chat in-app is super accessible, responsive, and helpful!! This element really adds to the value for me.

reviews.title: Fantastic habit tracker!
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this app! ADHD life saver ❤️  The visual grid tracking, the granular control over building good versus bad habits, and the built-in journal make it an incredibly powerful tool. It has been a huge help for my daily routine.

To make it a flawless experience, I’d love to see some future updates to the iOS widgets:

Interactive Main Widget: It would be amazing to check off habits right from the home screen, maybe with a fun visual pulse and a toggleable chime!

Quick-Append Journal Widget: A "Today" widget to quickly add a timestamp and note would be a game-changer for quick time tracking and combatting time blindness.

Overall, it's a beautifully built app with a fantastic foundation. Can't wait to see what the developers do next!

reviews.title: Quick suggestion
reviews.text: I love this app! I just have one request. I want to be able to track and check off a weekly habit even if I’ve already fulfilled my goal for the week. Maybe there’s a way to do this and I haven’t found it yet? For example, I want to do Habit A *at least* four times a week. But ideally more! And I’d like to track every time I do it. As the app is currently set up, if I track Habit A as being done Mon-Thurs, that habit is now marked as complete for the week and I can’t track that I also did it Friday and Sunday. But I don’t want my goal to be 7x a week! Please add an “at least” feature!

reviews.title: Tracking headaches health etc
reviews.text:
This exceptional app combines a daily tracker as well as capability for daily journals including word count! I log migraines, sleep, triggers, and painkiller use with its user friendly, intuitive interface and easy data export. You can also track movies, shows, books, and key takeaways, each task has optional notes attached.  Graphs make progress easy to visualize. I’ve tried so many apps—none are as thorough or powerful as this!
Their tech support is exceptional. 
Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Love it, almost perfect.
reviews.text:
Everything is so concise, neat, and easy to organize. This has been the best app to help me with my crazy ADHD. I am so thankful to the developers seriously.

I'm really hoping for the "Templates" update to the journal, that you will implement some kind of system that automatically creates a recurring note for an individual habit. I have a habit for "Lifting" at the gym. I like that there is an option to add a note with a checklist to it to tick which target areas I did that day. The only thing is I have to recreate the checklist each day. It's so close to being optimal, if templates could automatically recur each day for people with checklists inside of specific habits, and log which items on the checklist were completed while refreshing for the next day, I think this app would be perfect.

Also maybe the ability to hide the streak count for specific habits from the home menu, and capitalized words for the custom units just for neatness sake.

You guys did an amazing job ❤️💕

reviews.title: Nailed it!
reviews.text: I woke up one morning and said to myself, “I need a habit tracker” and shopped the App Store. This app looked very straight forward and turns out it was exactly what I was looking for. It’s very easy to use and offers flexibility at the same time being very simple and straightforward. I have it on my iPhone, iPad and MacBook and can add an entry from wherever I am. Love the way it looks in dark mode. Very cool that it has a body weight tracker. I hadn’t thought about that but love having it now. I also love that it offers habits that you want to reduce. That has really helped me a lot to be more conscious of things I would like to be doing less like drinking. I don’t use the journaling feature and wish there were a way to turn off the prompt which is a little annoying if you don’t use it. Other than that really great design!!

reviews.title: Super Helpful App
reviews.text:
I’ve been really enjoying this app. It’s great for me, as an AHDH adult to help me remember and prioritize my goals. 

I’m using the widgets for visibility and quick access to update the app. That’s been so helpful.
I will say that the widgets are… weirdly slow to update/respond? Like if I tap on the widget to complete a habit, there is a noticeable lag to mark it complete.

I’d also love to see the app provide more habit data from Health! I’m trying to develop a habit of Mindfulness Meditation, and I wish the app picked up the “mindful minutes” data, rather than forcing me to tap multiple times to add minutes to the habit.

reviews.title: Good with a few flaws
reviews.text:
This app is generally really good and it’s helped me a lot since getting it. But there’s one pretty significant feature missing, and it’s an option to pause habits and not lose your streak. For example if you become sick or go on a vacation and you can’t follow your regular habits and routine. It makes me feel guilty for losing my streaks, but like sometimes your routine has routine has to change for a few days! I feel like this would be fairly easy to implement and would make the app almost perfect to me. 

A way to set goals to be for a set amount of time (like exercising for 30 min for example) but still be able to check it off just once and not have to check off all the minutes would also be great. If my goal is to exercise for 30 min, I’m gonna do it all at once. I don’t want to have the click the check mark a bunch of times to get to it completed. 

If those two features were added it would be a perfect 5 stars to me!
